title: Toronto Rental Adventures
specs: Guided access to scenic trails through Ontario’s countryside near Lake Simcoe
Drivers must be 21 years of age
Maximum weight limit 300 lbs per rider
Single rider ATVs only, no adult passengers allowed
Valid government-issued photo ID or Driver’s License required at check-in
Basic driving skills required, no ATV experience necessary
Tours suitable for couples, families, and groups of friends
gap: Exact meeting point address not stated
blurb: Guests ride fully automatic, single-rider ATVs on guided tours through backcountry trails near Lake Simcoe in Georgina, Ontario. Tours are suitable for beginners and experienced riders, with safety briefings and helmets provided. Fuel and trail passes are included in the price.
extraNote: All bookings must be made by individuals 21 years or older · Full payment required at booking · All bookings are final and non-refundable · Cancellations less than 24 hours before tour charged 100% · Guests may reschedule with 24 hours notice, subject to availability and approval · Tours operate in most weather conditions; company may cancel or reschedule for unsafe weather or trail conditions · Arrive 15 minutes before tour start for safety orientation; late arrivals may shorten or cancel tour without refund
